title: GEMU - Consoles & Handhelds
description:
Play SNES, NES, Genesis, GBA, GB and GBC games in Garry's Mod on console + CRT stations and handheld SWEPs, with Player 2, save slots and spectator screens.

Server owners: this addon has no default game host. Host the GEMU web frontend with ROMs you are entitled to use, then set emu_url in garrysmod/cfg/gemu.cfg. Optional LiveKit spectator streaming is documented in the repository.

Optional controller support (XInput/DirectInput) is a separate client DLL on GitHub Releases: https://github.com/Nighthawk42/gemu/releases

Source, setup and issues: https://github.com/Nighthawk42/gemu

Credits: console and handheld models by unconid, CRT model by ivip, emulation cores from Emulatrix (MIT).
